chunks: Well, you are those who pleaded for them in the life of this world; but who will plead for them on the Day of Resurrection or be their security?
ai.seo_question: Who will plead for people on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah An-Nisa underscores the insufficiency of human intercession on the Day of Resurrection, reinforcing the principle that ultimate accountability rests solely with Allah. It serves as a warning against those who advocate for the righteous or the wicked in worldly matters, highlighting that neither their pleas nor their guardianship will suffice before Divine Justice.
